primary_time: Physical completion plus full two-sided hold recipe and all-time temperature/pressure operating upper bounds; all prescribed cases remain in completion counts.
tracking: Mean per-run MAE and worst absolute value across all nonempty recorded windows, with contributing temperature/pressure run counts; include incomplete trajectories.
endpoint_properties: Descriptive means among physical completions, with counts; no unspecified grade-acceptance claim.
reason: Use the same population for each tracking mean/maximum pair and make empty or prematurely terminated windows explicit. This reporting clarification changes neither simulation settings nor primary conformity classification.
